_meta.decisions_consumed_note: Descriptive only; no Universe-Decisions.md entry. DE-1/DE-2/DE-3 are this brief's own pre-registered decisions, not Universe-Decisions.md D-numbers.

universe.target_row_count_note: Confirmed via docs/Universe-Decisions.md D1 (15,349 clean_window=TRUE + 414 flagged) and by reading results/phase_5a/artifacts/sampling_frame.parquet directly (15,763 rows) -- not a live view scan (source_file is computed on the fly in src/data/canonical.py's CASE expression, not a stored column; a live COUNT(*) against momentum_events_canonical joins filtered_trades/filtered_quotes and is pathologically slow, same class as E1-T0's finding).

distance_to_boundary_audit.source_table_note: RAW table, not momentum_events_canonical -- min_volume_threshold and event_volume are not exposed on the canonical view (consistent with D4). Read under D4 Amendment A13's exemption: diagnostic only, entering no other computed quantity.

columns.event_volume: the D4-quarantined spine volume column itself -- named explicitly in CLAUDE.md's D4 list. A13 permits reading it paired with min_volume_threshold to audit the selection function; never for any other computed quantity.
columns.min_volume_threshold: 10**log_vol_threshold from data/collection_scripts/filter_events_power_law.py:65 -- persisted on momentum_events, non-null on all 23,268 rows. log_vol/log_mom/log_vol_threshold themselves are transient pandas variables inside that script, never persisted as columns anywhere -- the brief's citation of 'filter_events_power_law.py:42,43,62' names the script correctly but those three are not queryable column names.

distance_to_boundary_audit.banned_script_note: data/collection_scripts/filter_events_power_law.py is on CLAUDE.md's live D:\ hardcode banned-execution list -- never run it. Its output columns are read as already-persisted data on momentum_events; the script itself is not executed.

event_minute_bars_v2_schema.note: Tick-derived from filtered_trades (research/phase_6b/build_minute_bars_v2.py) -- not a spine numeric, not D4-quarantined. Its own high/low/volume are NOT the same columns as momentum_events' D4-quarantined event_volume/high -- never conflated.

de1_momentum_pct_signoff.note: momentum_pct read directly from momentum_events_canonical, used as a described response variable only -- never bucketing, never entering a computed statistic in any numbered phase. Phase 8's bucketing prohibition untouched.

de2_censoring_horizon.status: RESOLVED 2026-09-15 -- Cooper: 'end of tick data' (NOT the brief's suggested 'end of extended session').
de2_censoring_horizon.note: Per-event data availability, not a fixed clock boundary: the last minute bar actually present for that event in event_minute_bars_v2 (max minute_index/last_trade_ts for that (ticker, event_date_canonical, momentum_pct)). An event with no qualifying window end by its own last available bar is censored there, carried, and reported as its own share (DE-3).

de2_baseline_floor.status: DEFERRED 2026-09-15 -- Cooper, after seeing B_e's real distribution: the floor is not a percentile of that distribution, and its relevance is unclear pending the duration build (T2 proper). NOT blocking -- baseline_thin is left uncomputed (not defaulted to false) until Cooper sets a basis; T2's full window/duration build proceeds without it.
de2_baseline_floor.units: USD per 10-minute interval, matching B_e's own units (revised to dollar volume, see de2_volume_basis below)

de2_volume_basis.status: RESOLVED 2026-09-15 -- Cooper: dollar volume (volume x vwap per minute bar), not share volume, for BOTH B_e and the trailing 10-minute moving average used for window-end detection. Corrects e2_t2a_baseline.py's first version, which used share volume.
de2_volume_basis.confirmed_mechanics: baseline = mean of T-3..T-1's regular-hours dollar volume (USD per 10-min interval); window end = first point where the trailing 10-minute average dollar volume drops to <= 3x that baseline AND stays there for 10 consecutive minutes. Cooper confirmed this restatement directly.

window_definition.volume_basis: dollar volume (volume x vwap per minute bar), not share volume

excluded_years_note: Prior-session coverage in 2025 is ~1% and the baseline cannot be built -- SS6.
